headline: Make lead qualification consistent before outreach begins
capabilities: Enrich leads with firmographic, technographic, and intent data
Score and segment leads using ICP and BANT criteria for prioritization
Generate tailored outreach sequences and talking points
Automate SLA tracking and alerts to ensure timely follow-up
outcomes: Reduced lead qualification time from hours to minutes
Increased lead-to-meeting conversion through personalized engagement
Balanced workload across sales reps while maintaining SLAs
Freed team capacity to focus on strategic, high-value opportunities
why_try: A team can see why a lead is prioritized, what qualification evidence is missing, and what should be reviewed next without triggering outreach or CRM automation.

sample_prompts.label: Prioritize synthetic leads
sample_prompts.prompt: Which bundled synthetic leads should my team review first, and why did they score that way?

sample_prompts.label: Review BANT evidence
sample_prompts.prompt: Show the BANT evidence and missing qualification details for the strongest synthetic leads.

sample_prompts.label: Draft outreach ideas
sample_prompts.prompt: Draft outreach ideas for the synthetic hot leads, but do not send or schedule any communication.

sample_prompts.label: Recommend lead routing
sample_prompts.prompt: Recommend synthetic lead routing for manager review without assigning CRM owners.

sample_prompts.label: Draft the SLA plan
sample_prompts.prompt: Draft an SLA and escalation plan for the synthetic leads without activating alerts or automations.

sample_prompts.label: Summarize qualification evidence
sample_prompts.prompt: Summarize the synthetic qualified pipeline and clearly label every conversion and value assumption.

business_flow: Business development rep, account executive, or sales manager
